title: What is a prompt in AI? Plain answer | 50agents
description: A prompt is the text that tells an AI model what to do: the task, the context and the limits. How a prompt in a chat differs from one that runs daily.
h1: What is a prompt in AI?
definition: A prompt is the text you give an AI model to tell it what to do: the task, the context it needs and any limits.
In a chat you write a new prompt each time; inside an AI agent or an automation, a fixed prompt runs again and again on new data.

example.why: Four words are a whole prompt to Captain: it asks what it cannot guess, such as the currency. The AI agent it builds then runs on a standing prompt of its own, its instructions.
